'''Tony Vigliotti''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Coruscant Civil War]] on 4 November 2000 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|HBX]], according to Doug Faust's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1427">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-06-coruscant-civil-war-ii-4-nov-00d1427/ coruscant-civil-war-ii-4-nov-00], DeckTech (Doug "Phrim" Faust, 6 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-06-coruscant-civil-war-ii-4-nov-00d1427/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
